deployParams._comment: Maps 1:1 to TokenFactory.DeployParams. Amounts are human-readable; convert to base units at call time (token/USDC = 6 decimals, ETH = 18).
deployParams.name: Business Name Rewards
deployParams._seed_comment: usdcPairAmount and ethPairAmount are MINIMUMS of $2,000 USDC and $1,000 ETH — seed more if the merchant, an investor or PunchCard wants deeper pools. The token side of each pool is derived from the USD value seeded, so both pools always open at the same price regardless of the amounts.

rules._comment: Enforced by require() in TokenFactory.deploy() — check before spending gas.
rules.name: non-empty
rules.ipfsHash: non-zero bytes32; keccak256 of the pinned metadata CID. IMMUTABLE. See skoop-metadata.json for the shape.
rules.teamWallet: non-zero; IMMUTABLE FOREVER — no update function exists
rules.operator: non-zero; POS signer; IMMUTABLE after deploy
rules.ethPairAmount: >= $1,000 worth at the Chainlink ETH/USD price, and must equal msg.value. No upper bound.
rules._oracle: deploy() reverts if the ETH/USD feed is stale by more than 1 hour.

deployed._comment: Fill in after deploy, then set status to 'deployed' and commit.

launchPrice._comment: No longer something to hand-check — the contract derives the split so both pools open at the same price by construction.
